summary: After the broker drops the socket, nothing of the last connection carries over: the first packet after the reconnect has a price but no feed time (ft), trade time (ltt) or change (pc), and the frame has none of them.

notes: Partial updates overlay within a connection only: docs/port/market-data-frames.md, Partial-update feeds; lead correction 2026-11-09, .lane/107/decisions.md: a field a partial packet omits is unchanged, not unknown. The desktop drops its cached snapshots on a new connection; the web's Tradesmart adapter keeps its cache (declared).

deviations.reason: The web's Tradesmart adapter keeps its scrip cache across a reconnect (only Shoonya's _resubscribe_all clears it), so the first packet of the new connection, which has no trade time (ltt), goes out with the last connection's: a value from before the outage presented as current. The desktop starts each connection afresh.

The web's Tradesmart adapter keeps its scrip cache across a reconnect (only Shoonya's _resubscribe_all clears it), so the first packet of the new connection, which has no feed time (ft), goes out with the last connection's: a value from before the outage presented as current. The desktop starts each connection afresh.

The web's Tradesmart adapter keeps its scrip cache across a reconnect (only Shoonya's _resubscribe_all clears it), so the first packet of the new connection, which has no change (pc), goes out with the last connection's: a value from before the outage presented as current. The desktop starts each connection afresh.

The stream carries no OI for this instrument (a cash equity or an index); the web's TradeSmart adapter sends its safe_float/safe_int default (0) for a field the stream did not carry; the docs leave such a field out (web openalgo#2376, docs/api/websocket-streaming/quote.md), and so does the desktop.
